reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to carry around. On $28k a year I'm not paying extra for the convenience.
objection: I'd be paying for a pocket-size packaging format I have no use for. A regular bottle of magnesium costs less per month and I take it at home anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 for 30 days, with the batch lab report actually showing the real magnesium amount per capsule.
